import sys
input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().split()

n = int(data[0])
d = int(data[1])
heights = list(map(int, data[2:]))

# Initialize the DP array
dp = [1] * n
prev = [-1] * n

# Fill the DP array
for i in range(1, n):
    for j in range(i):
        if abs(heights[i] - heights[j]) >= d and dp[i] < dp[j] + 1:
            dp[i] = dp[j] + 1
            prev[i] = j

# Find the maximum length of the jump sequence
max_length = max(dp)
max_index = dp.index(max_length)

# Reconstruct the jump sequence
sequence = []
while max_index != -1:
    sequence.append(max_index + 1)
    max_index = prev[max_index]

# Print the result
print(max_length)
print(' '.join(map(str, sequence[::-1])))
